<div class="single-holder">
	<div class="article">
		<h1 class="headline">The Homestead</h1>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large is-resized"><img data-recalc-dims="1" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="800" height="191" data-attachment-id="2074" data-permalink="https://gnaraloostation.com/homestead-1/" data-orig-file="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/homestead-1.png?fit=800%2C191&amp;ssl=1" data-orig-size="800,191" data-comments-opened="1" data-image-title="Homestead" data-image-description="" data-image-caption="" data-large-file="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/homestead-1.png?fit=800%2C191&amp;ssl=1" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/homestead-1.png?resize=800%2C191&#038;ssl=1" alt="" class="wp-image-2074" style="width:760px;height:181px" /></figure>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Sitting high on an escarpment, with panoramic views of the dunes and the beautiful Indian Ocean is Gnaraloo Homestead &#8211; the beating heart of Gnaraloo Station. The Homestead offers a range of self contained, self catering accommodation to suit groups of all sizes.</strong></p>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">A short seven km drive north will drop you off in <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/gnaraloo-bay/" style="color:orange">Gnaraloo Bay</a>, an ideal location to launch your boat or stroll the sandy beaches and snorkel the amazing Ningaloo Reef or drive the same distance south and arrive at <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/3-mile-camp/" style="color:orange">3 Mile Camp</a> to take on <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/tombstone-tombies/" style="color:orange">Tombstones</a><strong>&nbsp;</strong>&#8211; our world-renowned surf break.</p>
<div style="height:20px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>

<div style="height:5px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<div style="height:20px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<div class="wp-block-columns has-background is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex" style="background-color:#f8f8f8">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:50%">
<p class="has-text-align-left wp-block-paragraph"><strong>• POWER &amp; FRESHWATER</strong><br>Facilities are equipped with power from 7 am to 11 pm, drinking water, and most with freshwater showers.<br><br><strong>• BOAT PARKING</strong><br>Most accommodations have ample parking for at least one boat. Please let us know upon booking if you are bringing several, or very large boats, so we can work to best accommodate you.</p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:50%">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>• DOGS</strong><br>Well behaved dogs are permitted onsite (fees and conditions apply), must be kept on a lead while in the accommodation areas, and cleaned up after.<br><br><strong>• TIPS</strong><br>For more information on recommended items to pack, read through our <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/know-before-you-go/" style="color:orange">Know before you go</a> section. We recommend that you prepare well for your visit here &#8211; the more self sufficient you are, the more comfortable your stay will be.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 style="text-align:center">1 Bedroom Cabins</h2>
<p style="text-align:left">One bedroom / open studio space stone cabins accommodate up to 4 adults in an open plan studio space with separate kitchen/dining area and ensuite.</p>
<p style="text-align:left">All have ocean views from their patios and gas BBQs.</p>

<h2 style="text-align:center">2&nbsp; Bedroom Cabins</h2>
<p style="text-align:left">One bedroom plus open studio space stone cabins accommodate up to 5 adults, with an open plan studio space with a bedroom, separate kitchen/dining area, and ensuite.<br />All have ocean views from their patios and gas BBQs.</p>

<h2 style="text-align:center">Fishing Lodge 1</h2>
<p>The Fishing Lodge accommodates up to 22 adults in 10 bedrooms with 2 communal kitchens, 3 separate toilet, shower ablutions and 2 shaded outdoor areas with gas BBQs. The entire Fishing Lodge can be rented or it can be divided into two sections for different groups. Fishing Lodge 1: 16 adults. Fishing Lodge 2: 6 adults.</p>

<h2 style="text-align:center">Fishing Lodge 2</h2>
<p>The Fishing Lodge accommodates up to 22 adults in 10 bedrooms with 2 communal kitchens, 3 separate toilet, shower ablutions and 2 shaded outdoor areas with gas BBQs. The entire Fishing Lodge can be rented or it can be divided into two sections for different groups. Fishing Lodge 1: 16 adults. Fishing Lodge 2: 6 adults.</p>

<h2 style="text-align: center">Shearing Shed</h2>
<p>The Shearing Shed accommodates up to 14 adults in dorm style beds with fridge, freezer, sink and gas BBQ, fully equipped kitchen. 2 shared ablution facilities are nearby.</p>
<div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow aligncenter" data-effect="slide"><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_container swiper-container"><ul class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_swiper-wrapper swiper-wrapper"><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="850" height="478" alt="Shearing Shed" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-1999" data-id="1999" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-gnaraloohomestead-shearingshed.jpg?resize=850%2C478&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="850" height="478" alt="Shearing Shed" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-1998" data-id="1998" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-gnaraloohomestead-shearingshed-setup.jpg?resize=850%2C478&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="850" height="478" alt="Shearing Shed" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-1997" data-id="1997" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-gnaraloohomestead-shearingshed-beds.jpg?resize=850%2C478&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li></ul><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-prev swiper-button-prev swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-next swiper-button-next swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a aria-label="Pause Slideshow" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-pause" role="button"></a><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_pagination swiper-pagination swiper-pagination-white"></div></div></div>

<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 style="text-align:center">Shearers Quarters</h2>
<p>The Shearers Quarters accommodate up to 26 adults in 13 bedrooms, communal kitchen, adjoining 2 shared ablution and shaded courtyard with gas BBQ.</p>
<div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow aligncenter" data-effect="slide"><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_container swiper-container"><ul class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_swiper-wrapper swiper-wrapper"><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="850" height="478" alt="" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-3567" data-id="3567" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/accommodation-gnaraloohomestead-shearersquarters-patio.jpg?resize=850%2C478&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="850" height="478" alt="" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-3569" data-id="3569" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/accommodation-gnaraloohomestead-shearersquarters-kitchen.jpg?resize=850%2C478&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="850" height="478" alt="" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-3570" data-id="3570" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/accommodation-gnaraloohomestead-shearersquarters-bedroom.jpg?resize=850%2C478&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li></ul><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-prev swiper-button-prev swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-next swiper-button-next swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a aria-label="Pause Slideshow" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-pause" role="button"></a><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_pagination swiper-pagination swiper-pagination-white"></div></div></div>
